blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Sunday warned that allegations involving Chinese funds linked to Vice President Sara Duterte could pose a threat “at the highest level” to the Philippines if proven true, as he confirmed that the government was thoroughly investigating the matter. “The most disturbing aspect of it is the Chinese money. That now rises to a national security issue,” Marcos said during a Kapihan interview in Singapore, stressing that the allegations must first be substantiated. “If it is true, it is a threat — a threat at the highest level to the Republic,” he added.
